page.overview:
Who is Droba?

Droba was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Droba was present when Glossu Rabban announced a festival with music, food and the legendary gladiator Argus Veer's first fight in seven years. Excited, he travelled with a crowd through the streets of Carthag. He was approached by his friend Dayvan, who asked him what was happening. Droba told him the news and them moved on with the rest of the crowd.
